Available Locations London, UK About this Role Ensuring the privacy of personal information is core to Cloudflare’s mission to help build a better Internet. We’re looking for an experienced counsel to help Cloudflare navigate the complicated challenges of processing personal data amid an ever-changing and diverse regulatory landscape. Specifically, you will oversee the functions of Cloudflare’s Office of the Data Protection Officer to manage the company’s existing privacy program and ensure the company continues to comply with all applicable data protection and privacy laws, including the EU General Data Protection Regulation (“GDPR”). You will also be responsible for overseeing Cloudflare’s responsible AI program and compliance requirements stemming from AI regulations, including the EU AI Act. Your focus will be on building, implementing, and maintaining privacy program and AI program elements, including working closely with the non-lawyers on the Data and Privacy Operations team to implement these programs.  We are looking for an exceptionally talented, energetic and friendly privacy attorney to join our team based in London. This role is ideal for someone who is a proactive self-starter and strategic thinker, who has a thirst for knowledge and continued growth, all while working as part of a great team. Understand and advise on the requirements related to cross-border data transfers globally. Collaborate with and advise product lawyers on Cloudflare’s privacy by design policies. Advise the Data and Privacy Operations team on handling data subject requests, records of processing activities, privacy and AI impact assessments, and more.  Advise the Data and Privacy Operations team on conducting and approving privacy and AI vendor reviews. Support the commercial transactions legal team in negotiating data processing addendums and similar contractual language under global privacy laws. Support the corporate legal team on data and privacy-related due diligence for M&A transactions as well as supporting post-acquisition integration tasks related to privacy and AI compliance. Advise on data protection implications of and legal requirements applicable to security and privacy incidents, exercising judgment and discretion while advising cross-functional teams on incident handling procedures and communications.  Create and contribute to playbooks and FAQ libraries for various teams to ensure they have the most current guidance related to privacy, data governance, and responsible AI.   Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience LLB/JD equivalent degree with strong academic credentials and admitted to practice law in one of the jurisdictions where Cloudflare has an office and/or be a U.S. or UK-qualified lawyer  10+ years of relevant legal experience counseling a global company on international privacy and data protection issues, preferably with time in-house at a technology company with established privacy compliance protocols as well as at a top regional or global law firm Expert knowledge of EMEA-region AI, privacy, and data protection laws, regulations and compliance regimes at all levels, including familiarity with industry-specific regimes  Solution-oriented business and legal counselor with a growth mindset and strong sense of humor Strong communication skills and cooperative team player. Lead with empathy and understanding while embracing diverse points of view. Flexibility to adapt and thrive in a fast paced environment. Come join us!  About the Department Cloudflare’s engineering teams build and maintain the systems and products that power our global platform. A global platform which is within approximately 50 milliseconds of about 95% of the Internet connected population, serving on average, over 46 million HTTP requests per second. About the Team Delivering this platform with high performance and efficiency depends on advanced Linux kernel and hardware capabilities, and that is where this team works. The Performance Team owns overall system and application performance across that fleet: resource optimization, instrumentation, and the tooling that lets us see what the hardware is actually doing. System memory sits alongside CPU cycles, network processing, and storage IOPS as a first-class resource, and how the kernel manages it is increasingly the thing that decides how hot we can safely run every machine we own. We work upstream first. Several of us maintain or regularly contribute to the Linux kernel, and our default is to fix problems in mainline rather than carry private patches. This role is built on that principle. The problem you would own Using memory efficiently is one of the highest-leverage problems we have. At our scale, how the kernel's memory-management subsystem behaves under pressure has direct consequences for both performance and cost. As DRAM prices climb, getting more out of the memory we already own is a real lever on infrastructure spend. Using custom low-overhead instrumentation on production servers, we have identified several scalability bottlenecks in the kernel memory layer that show up under real workloads. We are looking for an expert to take on these problems, fix them against production workloads, and drive the changes upstream. Solving them lifts efficiency and latency across the entire fleet rather than in one place. What you will do Diagnose and fix performance and scalability bottlenecks in the Linux kernel memory-management subsystem, informed by real production telemetry at a scale few environments can offer. Land your work upstream. We expect MM changes to go to mainline first and want you to keep doing the maintainership and review work that earns standing in the community. Build and extend low-overhead kernel instrumentation (tracepoints, BPF, perf) so we keep measuring before we change, and prove the impact afterwards. Partner with kernel, networking, storage, and product engineers across the company to turn observed system behavior into concrete MM improvements. Set technical direction for how Cloudflare uses, tunes, and evolves kernel memory management as we push utilization higher. Requirements Deep expertise in the Linux kernel memory-management subsystem: the page allocator, virtual memory and memory mapping, reclaim, and the locking and concurrency that hold it together. Cloudflare is building a new public Certificate Authority for the Internet. We are looking for a senior technical architect to help define the systems, protocols, and security architecture behind it. Design root and intermediate CA trust hierarchies, signing systems, HSM integration, key ceremonies, key rotation, backup, recovery, migration, and key-compromise response. Architect secure, resilient, and highly available issuance services capable of operating at Internet scale and across multiple geographic and failure domains. Design certificate lifecycle systems around ACME, domain and IP validation, CAA, Certificate Transparency, pre-issuance linting, revocation, renewal, and large-scale certificate replacement. Integrate Cloudflare’s MTC infrastructure, including CA logs, landmarks,, cosigning or mirroring, and interactions with relying parties. Define trust boundaries, security properties, and threat models covering key compromise, unauthorized issuance, software supply-chain compromise, operator error, malicious insiders, infrastructure failure, split views, and cryptographic migration. descriptionAr: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. An overview of this role We are looking for a Backend Engineer to join our Change Record team within GitLab’s Source Code stage . As AI agents increasingly write code alongside people, every change needs a clear, trustworthy record of what changed, why, and who or what made it. You’ll build that record into GitLab’s source code experience, for humans and agents alike. This is a backend-focused role for an engineer with full-stack experience who enjoys balancing work on existing systems with new product development. That work happens in one of GitLab’s oldest and most complex product areas, where you’ll use Ruby on Rails to improve a critical system serving GitLab.com, self-managed instances, and GitLab Dedicated. Source Code provides the interface layer, through Gitaly, to the Git repositories behind a large share of GitLab traffic, so you’ll help keep it reliable through performance tuning, caching, rate limiting, observability, and resiliency, collaborating with product, design, security, Gitaly, Code Review, and Source Code Experience teams. Supporting production systems and improving established experiences are central to the role, especially while you’re onboarding, and over time you’ll also help build experiences for developers working with agents. You'll work remotely from the United Kingdom or Poland. What you’ll do Develop secure, well-tested, performant features and improvements using Ruby on Rails and GraphQL, among other technologies. Work through complex requirements and legacy constraints to deliver clear solutions while protecting the reliability of this critical system. Design and maintain backend services, APIs, data models, and business logic that support intuitive source code workflows. Collaborate across functions and teams, both asynchronously and synchronously, and involve domain experts when their input will improve the outcome. Use AI agents for well-scoped work when they can speed up delivery without sacrificing quality, and critically review their output. Write maintainable code that follows GitLab's standards and contribute to constructive code reviews. Help strengthen reliability by monitoring production health metrics, participating in Tier 2 on-call, troubleshooting incidents, contributing to root cause analysis, and improving observability and resiliency. Share knowledge through code review, technical documentation, and everyday collaboration while learning from others. What you’ll bring Professional experience building backend web applications, services, or application programming interfaces, with experience using Ruby and GraphQL. An understanding of relational databases, structured query language, data modeling, caching, background processing, and backend performance practices. Experience with full-stack development to build and maintain user-facing workflows and their underlying systems. Experience writing backend unit and integration tests, with familiarity with the testing pyramid, Git, and collaborative code review processes. Clear written and spoken English communication skills, including sharing useful status updates in a remote, asynchronous environment. The ability to manage assigned priorities, work through ambiguity, take ownership of your work, and seek guidance when needed. Experience using AI coding agents to speed up software development while critically reviewing their output. Bonus: you’ve built agents or agent-based workflows that run in production, not just prototypes. About the team The functional team works across Europe and North America, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous collaboration. It includes four engineers, comprising both backend and frontend engineers. descriptionAr: Du studierst und willst mehr als einen „Nebenjob“? Du willst Verantwortung, klare Ziele und ein Umfeld, in dem Leistung zählt? Dann ist diese Werkstudentenrolle dein Einstieg in die Finanzberatung, mit strukturiertem Onboarding, Coaching und einem klaren Weg in ein Trainee-Programm. Diese Rolle ist unternehmerisch geprägt und bietet dir die Möglichkeit, dich aktiv einzubringen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln. Leistung und Eigeninitiative spielen dabei eine zentrale Rolle, gleichzeitig wirst du durch strukturiertes Onboarding, Coaching und ein erfahrenes Team unterstützt. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1+) sind erforderlich, da die Ausbildung, die Kommunikation im Team sowie die Perspektive Richtung IHK vollständig auf Deutsch stattfinden. Dein Aufgabenbereich Startphase (erste Wochen): Terminaufbau: Du vereinbarst Kundentermine (Telefon, Netzwerk, Leads) und baust eine saubere Pipeline auf. Prozesslernen: Du lernst Gesprächsleitfäden, Bedarfsermittlung, Nachbereitung und Dokumentationsstandards. Performance-Optimierung: Du arbeitest mit KPIs, bekommst Feedback und verbesserst systematisch deine Ergebnisse. Im weiteren Verlauf: Analyse & Vorbereitung: Du unterstützt bei der Analyse von Kundensituationen und bereitest Beratungsunterlagen strukturiert vor. Kundenkontakt: Du begleitest Gespräche (je nach Stand), übernimmst Follow-ups und sorgst für klare nächste Schritte. Dokumentation & Organisation: Du hältst Prozesse sauber, dokumentierst konsequent und stellst Verlässlichkeit sicher. Teamarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit einem leistungsstarken Team und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Aufgabenpakete. Das bieten wir dir Strukturierter Einstieg : Trainingsplan, Leitfäden, klare Standards Mentoring & Coaching : regelmäßiges Feedback, klare Ziele Leistungsorientierte Vergütung (Erfolgslogik – du wirst für Output belohnt) Skalierbare Perspektive : Option auf Übernahme ins Trainee-Programm Remote möglich – eigenverantwortlich statt “nach Uhr” Team mit Performance-Kultur : klare Kommunikation, klare Ergebnisse Nichts für dich, wenn… du einen typischen Werkstudentenjob mit “ein paar Stunden nebenbei” suchst du Telefon/Terminaufbau vermeiden willst dein Deutsch unter C1 liegt du lieber Sicherheit als Entwicklung priorisierst Muss Immatrikuliert (Uni/FH) Deutsch mindestens C1 (mündlich & schriftlich) Kommunikationsstärke, Verbindlichkeit, Zuverlässigkeit Eigeninitiative und strukturierte Arbeitsweise Lust auf Leistung und messbare Ergebnisse Wunsch Erste Erfahrung in Vertrieb, Service, Beratung, Sport-/Leistungskultur Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

descriptionAr: Deine Rolle Wir sind HeyHoney, ein wachsendes Unternehmen mit einer treuen Community und einem klaren Produkt. Diese Community ist eines unserer wertvollsten Assets – und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel. Bei uns erwarten dich Verantwortung, Geschwindigkeit, Flexibilität und viel kreativer Gestaltungsraum – verbunden mit der Möglichkeit und Erwartung, diesen aktiv zu nutzen. Während unser Head of Performance & Growth die Skalierung verantwortet, machst du unsere Marke jeden Tag erlebbar: Du entwickelst unsere organischen Kanäle, unseren Content und unsere Community-Formate weiter – vom ersten Konzept bis zum fertigen Reel, vom Community-Kommentar bis zum Event. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Creator, UGC-Creator und Freelancer zusammen und berichtest direkt an unsere Head of Performance & Growth. Dein Verantwortungsbereich Content & Social Media: Du betreust und entwickelst unsere organischen Kanäle – insbesondere Instagram, TikTok und Pinterest – und hast Trends, Plattform-Logiken und neue Formate immer im Blick. Content-Produktion: Du entwickelst Content-Ideen und setzt sie hands-on um – insbesondere Short-Form-Video. Dabei kannst du sowohl neuen Content produzieren als auch vorhandenes Material kreativ weiterdenken und daraus neue, plattformgerechte Inhalte entwickeln. Für Produktionen arbeitest du bei Bedarf mit UGC-Creator und Freelancer zusammen und steuerst diese eigenständig. Creator & UGC: Du identifizierst relevante Creator, baust Beziehungen auf und entwickelst ein nachhaltiges Netzwerk aus UGC-Creator, Freelancer und Partner, das unsere Marke langfristig voranbringt. Community Management: Du bist eine der Stimmen von HeyHoney. Du interagierst regelmäßig mit unserer Community, aktivierst sie und entwickelst Ideen, mit denen aus Kund echte Fans werden. Dabei entwickelst du Community-Formate, die Bindung und Retention stärken. Community Events: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team Ideen für Community Events und begleitest deren Umsetzung – von Planung und Partner-/Location-Auswahl bis zur Durchführung und Nachbereitung. Launch-Support: Für unsere Kollektions-Launches entwickelst du organische Content- und Community-Ideen und verzahnst sie eng mit unseren Paid-Aktivitäten. Analytics & Reporting: Du behältst relevante KPIs wie Reichweite, Engagement und Community-Wachstum im Blick, erkennst, welche Inhalte funktionieren, und leitest daraus konkrete Learnings und neue Content-Ideen ab. Was du mitbringst Du fühlst dich auf Social Media zu Hause und verstehst, warum Content funktioniert – oder eben nicht. Dabei ist uns dein Gespür für Content, Community und relevante KPIs wichtiger als eine bestimmte Anzahl an Berufsjahren. Idealerweise bringst du mindestens ein Jahr praktische Erfahrung im Bereich Social Media, Content oder Community mit – zum Beispiel aus einer Festanstellung, Werkstudentätigkeit, einem Praktikum, Freelance-Projekten oder eigenen Social-Media-Projekten. Du bist hands-on: Du kannst Content von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung begleiten und hast ein gutes Auge für Ästhetik, Trends und die unterschiedlichen Logiken von Instagram, TikTok & Co. Du verstehst Content Creation: Du kannst selbst drehen und schneiden und weißt gleichzeitig, wann Creator, UGC oder Freelancer die bessere Lösung sind. Du musst dabei nicht zwingend selbst vor der Kamera stehen – wichtiger ist, dass du gute Inhalte erkennst, entwickeln und umsetzen kannst. Du kannst Community: Du verstehst, wie aus Reichweite Interaktion und aus Interaktion echte Bindung entsteht. Wenn du bereits eine Community oder eigene Social-Media-Kanäle aufgebaut hast, umso besser. Du schreibst markensicher: Du hast ein gutes Sprachgefühl und triffst den Ton einer modernen Lifestyle-Brand. Du denkst in Zahlen: Reichweite, Engagement Rate, Watch Time oder Community-Wachstum sind für dich nicht nur Reporting-Zahlen. Du nutzt sie, um zu verstehen, was funktioniert und was wir beim nächsten Mal besser machen können. Du setzt um: Du wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jeder einzelne Schritt vorgegeben wird. Du bringst Ideen ein, probierst Dinge aus, lernst daraus und treibst deine Themen eigenständig voran. Uns ist dabei nicht wichtig, dass du schon jede dieser Aufgaben perfekt beherrschst. Wenn du Social Media verstehst, Lust hast, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, schnell lernst und HeyHoney gemeinsam mit uns weiterentwickeln möchtest, wollen wir dich kennenlernen. Was wir dir bieten Content, Community und Events sind bei uns bewusst noch nicht auserzählt. Das bedeutet: Du kommst nicht in ein fertiges System, sondern kannst aktiv mitgestalten. Echter Gestaltungsspielraum: Ein kleines, schnelles Team, kurze Wege und die Freiheit, Strukturen, Formate und Ideen selbst mit aufzubauen – im direkten Sparring mit unserer Head of Performance & Growth. Flexibles Arbeitsmodell: Wir sind Remote-First und offen für unterschiedliche Modelle – Vollzeit, Teilzeit oder Werkstudent. Entscheidend sind für uns dein Beitrag, deine Fähigkeiten und der messbare Output, nicht deine Anwesenheit im Büro. Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Die Rolle kann mit dir wachsen. Wenn du Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest und zeigst, dass deine Ideen funktionieren, bekommst du bei uns den Raum dafür. Miteinander, das zur Marke passt: Wir sind ein herzliches, offenes Team und leben den HeyHoney-Spirit auch intern – mit Augenhöhe, Vertrauen und einem wertschätzenden Miteinander, das auch über die Distanz trägt. Lust, HeyHoney mit aufzubauen? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Zeig uns dabei gerne mehr als deinen Lebenslauf: Welche Accounts, Reels, TikToks oder Formate findest du richtig gut? Was hast du selbst schon umgesetzt? Welche Community oder welchen Kanal hast du mitentwickelt? Links zu eigenen Accounts, Content-Beispielen, UGC-Projekten oder Events sind sehr willkommen. Auch eigene Projekte zählen für uns – es muss nicht alles aus einer klassischen Festanstellung stammen. Bei HeyHoney zählt, was du kannst und einbringst – unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht und geschlechtlicher Ide

descriptionAr: Deine Aufgaben bei uns Begleitung unserer Pflegehelden – Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für Pflegekräfte und begleitest sie engagiert und empathisch vom ersten Kontakt bis zur erfolgreichen Vermittlung. Individuelle Betreuung mit Herz – Du nimmst die Wünsche und Bedürfnisse der Pflegekräfte auf und gestaltest ihren Bewerbungsprozess unkompliziert und reibungslos . Passgenaue Stellenvermittlung – Du bringst Talente und Arbeitgeber zusammen, indem Du die Präferenzen der Pflegekräfte mit den besten Angeboten unserer Partnerunternehmen perfekt matchst . Feedback, das zählt – Du sammelst aktiv Rückmeldungen von Pflegekräften, um unsere Prozesse noch besser zu machen und die Candidate Experience auf das nächste Level zu heben. Teamwork, das Spaß macht – Gemeinsam mit dem Account Management entwickelst Du maßgeschneiderte Lösungen , um die Erwartungen unserer Kandidaten und Partnerunternehmen zu übertreffen . Präzise Dokumentation – Du hältst alle wichtigen Informationen zu den Kandidaten stets up to date und stellst sicher, dass unsere Kennzahlen jederzeit verfügbar und präzise sind. Mit Deiner Unterstützung schaffst Du ein echtes Win-Win für Pflegekräfte und Partnerunternehmen – und gestaltest aktiv die Zukunft der Gesundheitsbranche! Das bringst Du mit Kommunikationsstärke und Empathie – Du kannst komplexe Sachverhalte einfach erklären und gehst freundlich sowie lösungsorientiert auf Menschen zu. Organisationsgeschick – Du bist strukturiert und behältst auch bei vielen parallel laufenden Aufgaben den Überblick. Eigeninitiative und Lösungsorientierung – Du packst proaktiv an, erkennst Herausforderungen und entwickelst kreative Lösungen. Teamfähigkeit – Du arbeitest gerne im Austausch mit anderen und trägst aktiv zu einer positiven Teamdynamik bei. Digitale Affinität – Du fühlst Dich im Umgang mit Tools wie CRM-Systemen, Slack und Zoom wohl und lernst schnell neue Systeme kennen. Motivation und Lernbereitschaft – Du möchtest Dich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln und bist offen für Coachings und neue Herausforderungen. Hands-on-Mentalität – Du setzt Ideen in die Tat um und arbeitest ergebnisorientiert. Wir erwarten von Dir Deutschkenntnisse auf C2-Niveau , nachgewiesen durch Deinen Lebenslauf oder entsprechende Bescheinigungen. Du wirst nämlich mit Personen auf Kunden- und Kandidatenseite verhandeln, die Entscheidungen treffen werden. Eindeutigkeit in der Verständigung ist daher erforderlich. Das bieten wir Dir Top ausgestattetes Office in Berlin – Ein modernes Büro mit zentraler Lage , erstklassiger Anbindung und inspirierender Arbeitsumgebung . Attraktive Vergütung – Ein faires Grundgehalt plus ungedeckelte Provision , die Deinen Erfolg direkt belohnt. Intensive Einarbeitung – Starte mit einem 8-wöchigen Onboarding in Berlin, um uns und unsere Arbeitsweise von Grund auf kennenzulernen. Remote-Arbeit nach der Einarbeitung – Nach Deiner Einarbeitungszeit arbeitest Du bequem aus dem Homeoffice und besuchst uns einmal pro Quartal für eine Woche in Berlin zu unseren Team- und Companyevents. Übernahme aller Reisekosten – Wir übernehmen die Reise- und Übernachtungskosten für Deine Einarbeitungszeit und für die regelmäßigen Besuche in Berlin. Unbegrenzte Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten – Zeig, was in Dir steckt! Bei uns gibt es keine Limitationen – ob Du Dich fachlich weiterentwickeln, mehr Verantwortung übernehmen oder eine Führungsposition anstreben möchtest: Deine Karriere ist das, was Du daraus machst! Wir wachsen schnell und bieten Dir die Möglichkeit, gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen. Moderne Arbeitsausstattung – Laptop, Bildschirm und Headset stehen Dir für ein produktives Arbeiten zur Verfügung. Effiziente Tools und Systeme – Nutze Slack, Zoom und unser maßgeschneidertes CRM-System , um Deinen Arbeitsalltag effizient zu gestalten . Regelmäßige Team- und Networking-Events – Von After-Work-Sessions über Fußball oder Volleyball bis zu Teambuilding-Aktivitäten und Firmenläufen . Kostenlose Verpflegung – Frischer Kaffee, kühle Getränke, Snacks und Obst stehen Dir jederzeit zur Verfügung. Personalisierte Snack-Bestellungen – Über unsere wöchentliche REWE-Bestellung kannst Du Deine Lieblingssnacks direkt ins Büro liefern lassen. Friyay-Feeling – Jeden Freitag lassen wir die Woche gemeinsam mit Pizza und Bier im Büro ausklingen. Haustierfreundliches Büro – Dein Hund ist bei uns herzlich willkommen. 27 Urlaubstage pro Jahr – Für ausreichend Erholung und eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance . Pflegia ist eine digitale Plattform zur Vermittlung von Pflegekräften in ganz Deutschland. Unsere Mission: Pflegeeinrichtungen und qualifizierte Fachkräfte schnell, fair und passgenau zusammenzubringen – mit digitalen Lösungen, die wirklich funktionieren. Wir sind ein wachsendes Unternehmen mit Sitz in Berlin, das auf Eigenverantwortung, transparente Kommunikation und partnerschaftliches Arbeiten setzt. Bei uns zählt nicht, woher Du kommst – sondern wohin Du gemeinsam mit uns willst. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Our goal is to free 10,000 entrepreneurs from the burden of manual bookkeeping so they can focus on what they do best: growing their business. We are a fast-paced, fully remote company experiencing significant customer growth, and we're looking for passionate builders to join us. The Opportunity: own the domain of infrastructure We are looking for a highly motivated Senior Java Developer to join our team at Pathway. You will be responsible for the development and maintenance of our core application, specifically focusing on our billing and invoice generation systems. We need someone who is not only a strong coder but also proactive, eager to master new technologies, and capable of solving complex infrastructure and concurrency challenges. Tasks Application Development: Design, develop, and maintain robust billing applications and features (e.g., invoice generation systems) using Java 25. Concurrency & Performance: Architect and manage highly concurrent, multi-threaded application logic to ensure memory efficiency and system stability. Infrastructure & DevOps: Take ownership of infrastructure tasks, ensuring our systems are scalable, reliable, and well-maintained. Database Management: Utilize and optimize both SQL and NoSQL databases (e.g., Bigtable) to handle our evolving data requirements. Integrations: Design and maintain high-quality API integrations, utilizing modern standards like Swagger/OpenAPI. Cloud Operations: Implement and manage solutions within cloud environments (GCP preferred) Requirements 5+ years of professional experience in backend development, with a strong command of Java. Experience in AI Coding Tools & willingness to further drive AI Adoption in our Development process. A Structured Mindset: You excel at breaking down complex problems, clarifying requirements with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and designing clean, well-architected solutions. Concurrency & Multi-threading: Strong, proven experience in async environments and multi-threaded application logic, as this is fundamental to the core application. DevOps & Infrastructure: Experience in taking ownership of infrastructure and ensuring system scalability and reliability. Problem-Solving Skills: Excellent debugging, troubleshooting, and analytical skills. You're comfortable navigating ambiguity and finding the root cause of an issue. Strong Collaboration Skills: You communicate clearly and work effectively within a team-oriented environment. You have experience with Git, continuous deployment pipelines (like Gitlab), and agile practices like monthly scope planning and regular code reviews. Benefits Flexibility: Remote-first and family-friendly working hours. You decide when you work. No office presence required. Development: Coaching budget, mentoring, and a diverse team. Vacation: 30 days off to recharge. Amazing Team events : last one was Mallorca in 2026 Compensation: An attractive salary package awaits you. Growth Curve: Take on responsibility and grow with us. You’ll be responsible for managing software sales, bookings, and revenue, while building strong relationships with new and existing customers who rely on GitLab to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, and reduce security and compliance risk. Reporting to the VP, Central EMEA, you’ll hire and develop top talent, set clear territory and industry strategies, and ensure your team’s sales plans align with GitLab’s overall growth goals in this market. In your first year, you’ll focus on building a strong team culture, deepening our presence with German clients, and consistently meeting or exceeding performance objectives in a fast-paced, open source software and SaaS environment. descriptionAr: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in the US EST. About Product Management As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own the experience for your product as well as its roadmap and competitive positioning, and you will collaborate with company leadership on setting your product's goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential. Product Managers are the bridge that connects R&D to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers. The role As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you'll own the Grafana Labs offerings that run outside our standard multi-tenant SaaS. That includes Grafana Federal Cloud , for organizations that need FedRAMP-authorized observability: US federal agencies; state, local, and education (SLED) customers; and commercial companies that sell FedRAMP offerings of their own. It also includes Grafana Cloud Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC) , which delivers the full Grafana Cloud experience while the customer pays the infrastructure bill directly to their cloud provider, saving them significantly at scale. Your mission is to make Grafana Labs the obvious choice for organizations that can't use standard SaaS because of compliance, data, or cost-at-scale constraints. Deployment choices change the product: features that are simple in standard SaaS can be hard, expensive, or impossible in a regulated or customer-owned environment. You’ll be responsible for adapting existing Grafana Cloud capabilities to these environments, deciding which features come in, which wait, and which stay out, and occasionally building something specific to BYOC or Federal Cloud. You'll also help shape which deployment models we offer next. Along the way, you’ll use AI tools daily to speed up research, analyze product signals, and develop positioning, applying strong judgment to the results. As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you will:  Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Grafana Bring Your Own Cloud and Grafana Federal Cloud products, using product data and market research to balance customer value against engineering cost and technical constraints Own positioning, messaging, and differentiation for these products, including how they compare to regular Grafana Cloud, and partner with Product Marketing on launches, competitive analysis, enablement, and demand programs Partner with Engineering and Technical Program Management on buildouts for these environments, balancing customer timelines with engineering capacity Work directly with customers, prospects, and the field on strategic deals and brief partners, resellers, and analysts on our deployment options Partner with Security, Compliance, and Legal to work through product changes affecting our authorization or existing customer commitments We’re excited about you because you have 5+ years of product management experience on a technical B2B product, or a technical background (software engineering, solutions architecture, SRE, or technical program management) plus a demonstrated move into product ownership Hands-on experience with a non-standard SaaS deployment model, such as self-managed, air-gapped, sovereign, BYOC, single-tenant, or FedRAMP/government cloud, and a firsthand understanding of how it changes the product, its operations, and its economics Experience with cloud infrastructure, platform software, or developer tools Clear product and go-to-market judgment: you've shaped what a product should be and how it's positioned and sold, not only when it ships Interest in working with US public sector customers and learning their needs and buying cycles. Deep compliance expertise isn't required. Experience leading across multiple teams without direct authority, with excellent written and verbal communication in a remote, globally distributed organization Bonus Points Experience selling to or building for US federal, state, or local government customers, or other highly regulated industries Familiarity with government or sovereign cloud frameworks, such as FedRAMP, StateRAMP/GovRAMP, BSI C5, or SecNumCloud, or with offerings

descriptionAr: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in Germany. About Product Management As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own the experience for your product as well as its roadmap and competitive positioning, and you will collaborate with company leadership on setting your product's goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential. Product Managers are the bridge that connects R&D to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers. The role As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you'll own the Grafana Labs offerings that run outside our standard multi-tenant SaaS. That includes Grafana Federal Cloud , for organizations that need FedRAMP-authorized observability: US federal agencies; state, local, and education (SLED) customers; and commercial companies that sell FedRAMP offerings of their own. It also includes Grafana Cloud Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC) , which delivers the full Grafana Cloud experience while the customer pays the infrastructure bill directly to their cloud provider, saving them significantly at scale. Your mission is to make Grafana Labs the obvious choice for organizations that can't use standard SaaS because of compliance, data, or cost-at-scale constraints. Deployment choices change the product: features that are simple in standard SaaS can be hard, expensive, or impossible in a regulated or customer-owned environment. You’ll be responsible for adapting existing Grafana Cloud capabilities to these environments, deciding which features come in, which wait, and which stay out, and occasionally building something specific to BYOC or Federal Cloud. You'll also help shape which deployment models we offer next. Along the way, you’ll use AI tools daily to speed up research, analyze product signals, and develop positioning, applying strong judgment to the results. As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you will:  Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Grafana Bring Your Own Cloud and Grafana Federal Cloud products, using product data and market research to balance customer value against engineering cost and technical constraints Own positioning, messaging, and differentiation for these products, including how they compare to regular Grafana Cloud, and partner with Product Marketing on launches, competitive analysis, enablement, and demand programs Partner with Engineering and Technical Program Management on buildouts for these environments, balancing customer timelines with engineering capacity Work directly with customers, prospects, and the field on strategic deals and brief partners, resellers, and analysts on our deployment options Partner with Security, Compliance, and Legal to work through product changes affecting our authorization or existing customer commitments We’re excited about you because you have 5+ years of product management experience on a technical B2B product, or a technical background (software engineering, solutions architecture, SRE, or technical program management) plus a demonstrated move into product ownership Hands-on experience with a non-standard SaaS deployment model, such as self-managed, air-gapped, sovereign, BYOC, single-tenant, or FedRAMP/government cloud, and a firsthand understanding of how it changes the product, its operations, and its economics Experience with cloud infrastructure, platform software, or developer tools Clear product and go-to-market judgment: you've shaped what a product should be and how it's positioned and sold, not only when it ships Interest in working with US public sector customers and learning their needs and buying cycles. Deep compliance expertise isn't required. descriptionAr: About the Team The Applied AI Engineering team is responsible for ensuring the safe and effective deployment of Generative AI applications for developers and startups. We act as a trusted advisor and thought partner for our customers, working to build an effective backlog of GenAI use cases for their industry and drive them to production through strong technical guidance. OpenAI's customers represent a range of diverse backgrounds and maturity, from early-stage startups to late-stage startups. About the Role We are seeking a technically proficient, business-minded Applied AI Engineer to help push the frontier of advanced AI with our strategic startup customers. You'll work with some of the most exciting AI startups in the world, guiding them through ideation, development, delivery, and scaling to accelerate and maximize the value of what they build on our platform. You will have the opportunity to work on the most novel and creative use cases being built on our API, serving as a critical partner in collecting and delivering high-fidelity product and model feedback internally. You will collaborate closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Applied Research, and Product teams, and you will report to the Startups Applied AI Lead. This role is based in our Singapore office. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: Partner closely with strategic startup customers as their technical thought partner to build novel applications on our API, helping them rapidly move from ideation to scale. Provide proactive guidance to maximize business impact and accelerate application development. Experiment and prototype alongside customers, demonstrating practical use cases. Contribute to open-source resources and scale the function by sharing knowledge, codifying best practices, and publishing useful resources. Synthesize and deliver valuable feedback to the Product and Research teams. Build relationships within the startup ecosystem, serving as a technical partner to both individual customers and the broader community. Partner with the Sales team across startup accounts to identify customer opportunities, align technical work with business goals, and help customers bring AI applications to production. You might thrive in this role if you: Have ability to speak Mandarin is a requirement as you will be working with Mandarin-speaking customers and/or vendors in the role. Have 5+ years of experience as a software engineer, ML engineer or equivalent, ideally in a startup environment; experience as a founder or founding engineer is highly valued. Have passion for startups and a belief in their potential to become future large enterprises. Are proficient in Python, JavaScript, and a strong grasp of AI/LLM best practices. Built and/or delivered prototypes on top of our API platform. Can proactively identify opportunities for maximizing our customers’ business value through leveraging the OpenAI API. Own problems end-to-end and are willing to pick up whatever knowledge you're missing to get the job done. Have a humble attitude, an eagerness to help your colleagues, and a desire to do whatever it takes to make the team succeed. Are an effective, high throughput operator who can drive multiple concurrent projects and prioritize ruthlessly. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement . Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. descriptionAr: Über nara nara erledigt die Arbeit, die in IT-Abteilungen jeden Tag anfällt. Mitarbeitende schreiben nara in Microsoft Teams oder rufen an. nara findet die Ursache und löst das Problem direkt in den Systemen, auf Servern und Geräten, vom Drucker, der nicht mehr druckt, bis zum Onboarding mit Konten, Zugängen und Software. Jedes Unternehmen legt selbst fest, was nara allein erledigt und wo ein Mensch freigibt. Wir haben nara 2025 in Würzburg gegründet. Heute läuft nara produktiv bei Unternehmen aus Fertigung, Handel, Versicherung und IT-Services. Unsere Kunden sind Unternehmen ab etwa 1.000 Mitarbeitenden mit eigener IT-Abteilung sowie Managed Service Provider. Das Produkt ist im Einsatz. Jetzt soll jede IT-Leitung in Deutschland nara kennen. Dafür suchen wir jemanden, der Growth komplett übernimmt, vom ersten Kontakt bis zum Termin, und im Vertrieb selbst mit anpackt. Die Rolle Du sorgst dafür, dass nara so schnell wie möglich wächst. Wie du das schaffst, entscheidest du. Unser Vertrieb kümmert sich vor allem um Demos, Beziehungen und Abschlüsse. Alles davor liegt bei dir: Zielkunden finden, Kampagnen aufsetzen, Entscheider ansprechen, Gespräche vereinbaren. Du bist aber auch Teil des Vertriebs, führst eigene Termine und unterstützt, wo es nötig ist. Ein Marketingteam und feste Prozesse gibt es noch nicht, die baust du mit uns auf. Dein Ziel: So viele qualifizierte Termine für unseren Vertrieb wie möglich, jeden Monat mehr als im Monat davor. Daran messen wir dich. Deine Aufgaben Du findest heraus, über welche Wege wir IT-Leiter und Entscheider in unseren Zielunternehmen am besten erreichen. Du sprichst sie selbst an, am Telefon, auf LinkedIn, per E-Mail oder persönlich. Du wählst Messen und Events aus und sorgst dafür, dass wir von dort mit konkreten Gesprächen zurückkommen. Du setzt Kampagnen online und offline auf, misst, was funktioniert, und stellst ab, was nicht funktioniert. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns die Website und unsere Inhalte weiter, damit Interessenten auch von selbst auf uns zukommen, zum Beispiel über Webinare. Du führst eigene Termine und übergibst qualifizierte Gespräche an unseren Vertrieb, mit dem du eng zusammenarbeitest. Wenn der Bereich wächst, baust du ein Team auf. Was du mitbringst Du hast mindestens einmal etwas von null zum Laufen gebracht: einen Kanal, ein Nebenprojekt, ein eigenes Geschäft oder einen Bereich in einem frühen Startup. Du kannst Zahlen dazu nennen. Du hast im B2B-Bereich Leads generiert und weißt, woran man einen guten Termin von einem schlechten unterscheidet. Du telefonierst gern, auch kalt. Du arbeitest selbstständig und triffst Entscheidungen, ohne auf Anweisungen zu warten. Du setzt Tools und Automatisierung ein, wo sie dich schneller machen. Du kennst die Regeln für Kaltakquise in Deutschland (UWG, DSGVO) und hältst dich daran. Du sprichst und schreibst fließend Deutsch und gut Englisch. Erfahrung im B2B-Softwarevertrieb ist von Vorteil, idealerweise im ITSM-Umfeld oder mit IT-Abteilungen und Managed Service Providern als Kunden. Ein Muss ist das nicht. Du benutzt AI nicht nur um Emails oder Nachrichten verfassen zu lassen sondern zur vollen Automatisierung. Was du wissen solltest Es gibt keine klassische Einarbeitung, du startest direkt. Am Anfang hast du kein eigenes Team und setzt vieles selbst um, in enger Abstimmung mit uns und unserem Vertrieb. Du bekommst keine täglichen Aufgaben vorgegeben, sondern ein Ziel. Als Startup ändern sich bei uns Prioritäten schnell, und vieles ist noch nicht dokumentiert. Was wir bieten Festgehalt von 70.000 bis 90.000 Euro brutto im Jahr, je nach Erfahrung Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm Volle Verantwortung für den Growth-Bereich ab dem ersten Tag Freie Einteilung deiner Arbeitszeit, hybrid in Würzburg oder komplett remote Budget für Tools, Kampagnen und Messen, über das du mitentscheidest Direkter Draht zu allen Entscheidern So bewirbst du dich Wir halten den Prozess kurz. Du schickst uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Zeilen dazu, was du bisher aufgebaut hast, am besten mit Zahlen. Ein klassisches Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Wir lernen uns in einem ersten Gespräch per Video kennen. Im zweiten Gespräch triffst du die Gründer, gern auch vor Ort in Würzburg. Danach entscheiden wir innerhalb weniger Tage. About The Role: In this position, you'll play a crucial role in shaping our go-to-market strategy and driving data-informed decision-making within the Japan/APAC region. This position sits at the intersection of sales, strategy, and operations, offering the opportunity to significantly impact Notion's growth trajectory. You'll work closely with sales leadership and cross-functional teams to optimize processes, deliver actionable insights, and support key strategic initiatives. You will report directly to the Head of Field Strategy & Operations. ability to analyze and interpret data, provide actionable insights, and deliver measurable results Expert proficiency with core sales tools (e.g. Salesforce, Gong, Outreach, etc.) and best practices for sales data management Ability to apply AI-powered tools to accelerate analysis, uncover trends, and translate complex sales data into actionable business insights. descriptionAr: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. An overview of this role As a Senior Manager, Customer Success Architects , you will lead a distributed Asia Pacific team of Customer Success Architects and Customer Success Managers that help customers realize value from GitLab through strong adoption, measurable outcomes, and trusted partnership. You will partner closely with both executive sponsors and day-to-day end users/practitioners to drive adoption and measurable outcomes. Reporting to the Sr Director of Customer Experience, APJ , you will coach Customer Success Managers & Customer Success Architects to support account health across onboarding, adoption stages, executive business reviews, and renewals, while also improving how the team works. This is a people leadership role with broad scope: you will develop talent, strengthen customer relationships, and partner across Sales, Product, Engineering, and other teams so customers are supported through growth, change, and escalation. What you'll do Lead a team of Customer Success Architects & Managers focused on customer adoption, account health, customer satisfaction, and advocacy. Ensure delivery of the Success package entitlements and increase value by driving usage and consumption  Coach team members through regular feedback, development support, and career growth conversations to strengthen knowledge, communication, and execution. Partner with the Sr Director of Customer Experience APJ and Sales stakeholders  to define team goals, clarify responsibilities, and align priorities with company direction. Manage resource assignments, staffing levels, and hiring activity to support team coverage and customer needs. Develop senior-level relationships with customers and support the team in building trusted advisor partnerships. Collaborate with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, Professional Services, Renewals and other internal teams to create a consistent customer experience. Support customers during escalations by working with other leaders to coordinate clear, effective responses. Improve the processes and tools used by the team and oversee initiatives tied to objectives and key results. What you'll bring Experience leading customer-facing delivery teams in software, technology, consulting, sales, or customer success environments preferably in DevOps or related domain. Ability to guide teams that drive software adoption and manage customer relationships across onboarding, adoption, business reviews, and renewals. Knowledge of software development lifecycle practices, related tools, and agile or DevOps ways of working. Familiarity with cloud or container technologies such as Kubernetes and Docker, application security concepts such as static application security testing (SAST) and dynamic application security testing (DAST), or cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and Microsoft Azure. Skill in translating strategy into clear initiatives, coordinating execution, and tracking delivery across competing priorities. Capability to lead distributed teams across regions, cultures, and lines of business, while working effectively with senior executives and external stakeholders. Willingness to travel occasionally for customer meetings and team events, as needed. Strength in communication, coaching, feedback, delegation, planning, and process improvement. descriptionAr: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. An overview of this role As a Strategic Account Executive for the Northeast region, you'll drive GitLab's enterprise growth by helping some of the area's most influential organizations adopt, implement, and expand their use of our AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You'll focus on strategic enterprise accounts, guiding customers through complex digital and DevSecOps transformations and driving pipeline generation that translates into measurable Net ARR and long-term expansion. In this role, you'll act as a key connector between customer stakeholders and GitLab's field organization so GitLab is seen as a trusted, long-term partner across the full sales cycle. In your first year, you'll be expected to build a strong enterprise portfolio across your territory, create repeatable sales motions, and consistently forecast and report on deal progress and account health. What you'll do Drive strategic growth by leading GitLab's enterprise accounts across the Northeast, serving as a trusted technology advisor to industry leaders in your territory. Orchestrate winning sales strategies by bringing together Solutions Architects, Customer Success experts, Sales Development, Channel & Alliances, and other technical specialists to deliver transformative, AI-powered DevSecOps solutions. Shape the future of software development by crafting innovative solutions that align GitLab's platform with customers' long-term vision, compliance needs, and business objectives. Build deep, strategic partnerships by mastering your customers' industry landscape, success metrics, and growth trajectories so you can position GitLab as their indispensable technology ally. Design and execute strategic account plans, including opportunity mapping, stakeholder alignment, and multi-threaded engagement, to expand GitLab usage within new and existing major accounts. Lead end-to-end customer journeys from initial discovery through evaluation, negotiation, and successful implementation, ensuring a consistent, high-quality experience at every stage of the sales cycle. Champion continuous improvement by contributing to forecasting and pipeline reviews, conducting sophisticated win/loss analyses, and sharing strategic insights that refine our go-to-market approach. Prepare and deliver compelling customer-facing and internal presentations, proposals, and recommendations that clearly communicate value, business outcomes, and the path to long-term partnership with GitLab. What you'll bring Experience driving complex B2B software sales cycles with enterprise customers, ideally in DevSecOps, software development tools, or adjacent SaaS solutions. Background selling into large, strategic enterprise accounts in the Northeast United States, with the ability to build trusted C-level and senior stakeholder relationships across business and technical teams. Knowledge of the Northeast enterprise market, including key industries, buying centers, and decision-making dynamics, with the ability to build and nurture a relevant professional network. Ability to drive new business acquisition and expansion within enterprise accounts through consultative, multi-stakeholder sales motions that lead to sustainable, long-term customer partnerships. Experience collaborating with channel and strategic partners to generate pipeline, co-sell, and support successful customer adoption. Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to lead account strategy, influence internal and external stakeholders, and remain calm under pressure. Ability to work in line with GitLab's values, use GitLab and Salesforce in your daily work, and travel as needed while following company travel policies. About the team The Enterprise Sales team is responsible for driving growth, adoption, and long-term value for GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform with our largest and most strategic customers. As a Strategic Account Executive focused on the Northeast, you'll be part of a distributed, all-remote team that works asynchronously across regions and partners closely with GitLab's sales engineering, marketing, and customer success teams. We value transparency, collaboration, and a consultative approach, and we support one another through shared account planning, regular deal reviews, and knowledge sharing focused on enterprise customers across the Northeast region. The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews

descriptionAr: Ben jij de volgende stagiair bij onze afdeling Recruitment van Cordaan? Wij zijn namelijk op zoek naar jou! Als stagiair ga je nauw samenwerken met ons team van ervaren recruiters en krijg je de kans om bij verschillende taken en events te ondersteunen. Deze stage is een geweldige kans voor een professionele groei en ontwikkeling, in het hart van Amsterdam, waarbij je ook nog een maatschappelijke bijdrage levert. Interesse? Lees dan verder! Wie zijn wij? Cordaan is een toonaangevende zorgorganisatie in Amsterdam en onze afdeling recruitment speelt een cruciale rol in het aantrekken, selecteren en behouden van talent. Ons team bestaat uit acht enthousiaste recruiters die elke dag werken aan het optimaliseren van ons wervingsproces. We zoeken continu naar creatieve manieren om mensen enthousiast te maken voor werken in de zorg, zoals bijvoorbeeld banenmarkten of via zij-instroomtrajecten. Je kunt meer informatie vinden op onze website www.cordaan.nl en www.werkenbijcordaan.nl . Binnen de Human Resources, Kwaliteit en Innovatie afdeling (HRK&I) werken meer dan 100 mensen, verdeeld over diverse teams zoals HR Advies, HR Operations, HR Expertise, Verzuim, Recruitment en Leren en ontwikkelen. Je komt dus in een grote en dynamische HR-omgeving terecht! Je werkzaamheden als stagiar Tijdens je stageperiode ben je verantwoordelijk voor allerlei leuke en uitdagende taken! Zoals: → Contact onderhouden met hiring managers en kandidaten; → Proactief werven middels de juiste doelgroepstrategie; → Vacatureteksten opstellen; → Assisteren bij het screenen van cv's; → (Telefonische) gesprekken met kandidaten voeren; → Kandidatenbestanden beheren; → Bijbehorende administratieve werkzaamheden. Daarnaast krijg je de kans om mee te helpen met: → Analyseren van wervingsdata en -trends; → Verbeteren van de candidate experience; → Deelnemen aan carrièrebeurzen, wervingscampagnes en het maandelijkse event Banen en Bitterballen! Wat bieden wij? We bieden je een mooie kans om praktische ervaring op te doen binnen een dynamische en professionele omgeving. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om je vaardigheden verder te ontwikkelen, waardevolle kennis op te doen, een breed beeld te krijgen van de werkzaamheden binnen een grote HR-afdeling en een netwerk op te bouwen binnen de zorgsector. Je krijgt een stagevergoeding van €513,81 bruto per maand op basis van fulltime beschikbaarheid (36 uur per week). Bij Cordaan vinden we het belangrijk om te werken met stagiairs, omdat jullie een frisse kijk op onze processen hebben en we het geweldig vinden om talent vroegtijdig te ontdekken en te ontwikkelen. We helpen je graag bij je professionele groei en bereiden je voor op een succesvolle carrière in Recruitment/HR. We kijken ernaar uit om samen te werken met een gemotiveerde stagiair die ons team komt versterken. Interesse? Lijkt het je leuk om bij ons aan de slag te gaan? Solliciteer dan direct! Wil je (eerst) meer informatie? Neem gerust contact met ons op! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

descriptionAr: À propos de PropertyOS PropertyOS est une solution SaaS dédiée à la digitalisation de la gestion immobilière. Notre ambition : permettre aux propriétaires et gestionnaires de centraliser leurs biens, leurs locataires, leurs finances, leurs documents et leurs tâches au sein d'une plateforme unique. Nous développons une solution moderne qui répond aux enjeux de simplification, d'organisation et de suivi du patrimoine immobilier. Pour accompagner notre développement commercial, nous souhaitons constituer un premier réseau de partenaires indépendants motivés par la technologie, l'immobilier et l'entrepreneuriat. 🚀 Votre mission En tant que partenaire commercial indépendant, vous contribuez au développement de PropertyOS en identifiant des professionnels susceptibles d'être intéressés par notre solution. Selon le cadre de partenariat convenu, vos missions pourront notamment comprendre : Identifier des prospects : propriétaires, investisseurs immobiliers et professionnels de la gestion locative. Faire connaître PropertyOS : présenter les bénéfices de la solution et partager les supports de communication mis à disposition. Générer des opportunités commerciales : mettre en relation des prospects qualifiés avec PropertyOS. Contribuer au développement du réseau : faire connaître la solution auprès de votre réseau professionnel. Suivre vos opportunités : utiliser les outils mis à disposition pour suivre les prospects que vous avez apportés. Les missions de mise en relation ne comprennent pas la négociation ou la conclusion de contrats au nom de PropertyOS. Toute mission commerciale plus étendue devra faire l'objet d'un cadre contractuel adapté. 💰 Une rémunération liée à vos résultats Nous souhaitons développer un modèle de partenariat fondé sur la performance. La rémunération sera définie contractuellement selon la nature de la mission et les résultats obtenus. Le principe : valoriser concrètement les opportunités commerciales qui contribuent au développement de PropertyOS. Les conditions précises de rémunération, les modalités d'attribution des ventes et les échéances de paiement seront communiquées avant le démarrage du partenariat. Il s'agit d'une opportunité de collaboration indépendante, et non d'un emploi salarié. Aucun revenu minimum ni volume de ventes garanti n'est annoncé. 🎯 Le profil recherché Nous sommes ouverts à différents parcours professionnels. Vous pourriez correspondre à ce partenariat si vous : Avez une fibre commerciale et aimez créer des relations professionalnelles. Vous intéressez à l'immobilier, aux logiciels SaaS ou aux nouvelles technologies. Savez identifier des opportunités et communiquer clairement. Faites preuve d'autonomie, de sérieux et de professionnalisme. Souhaitez développer une activité indépendante en complément ou à titre principal. Une expérience préalable dans la vente de logiciels ou l'immobilier est appréciée, mais n'est pas indispensable. Nous nous intéressons avant tout à votre motivation, à votre capacité à comprendre les besoins des clients et à votre envie de participer au développement d'un projet technologique. 🤝 Ce que nous mettons à votre disposition Une solution logicielle en développement continu. Des supports pour comprendre et présenter PropertyOS. Un cadre de partenariat commercial défini à l'avance. Des outils de suivi des opportunités commerciales, selon les modalités retenues. Nice to have: Tailwind CSS , Prisma , PostgreSQL or Supabase . Python and FastAPI for backend services. Docker and Kubernetes basics; experience with real-time features, audio or AI products. descriptionAr: Intro For this position we are only looking for candidates located in Greece, Germany or Austria . Nairon GmbH is a Swiss startup building AI voice agents that answer and make phone calls for businesses. Our platform runs real-time conversations over the phone and on the web, connected to our customers' telephony and business tools. We value clear communication, thoughtful engineering, and a collaborative approach to problem-solving. Join us as we continue to develop tools that make a difference. Tasks As a Voice AI Engineer at Nairon GmbH, you will make our agents sound fast, natural and reliable in live calls. Your responsibilities will include: Improving turn-taking: when the agent speaks, waits, yields or gets interrupted, including voice activity and end-of-turn detection. Cutting end-to-end latency across speech recognition, language models and speech synthesis, and making provider failover seamless. Optimising how we use LLMs in conversation: prompting, tool calls, streaming and speculative or parallel requests. Serving our own speech models (STT and TTS) on GPUs, measuring throughput and time to first audio. Fine-tuning speech and language models for our customers' languages and voices. Building evaluation: test calls, benchmarks and quality metrics that tell us when a change really helps. Requirements Experience: A senior or strong mid-level engineer with production experience in real-time audio, conversational AI or ML model serving. Technical Skills: Required: Strong Python , including asyncio and streaming pipelines. Hands-on work with speech (STT, TTS, VAD) and LLM APIs in latency-sensitive systems. Model serving on GPUs, for example with vLLM or similar, and the basics of batching and memory limits. Nice to have: LiveKit Agents , pipecat or WebRTC. Fine-tuning (LoRA or full) of speech or language models. Audio signal processing such as echo cancellation or noise suppression. German, or experience with German-language speech data. Communication: English proficiency is essential , both written and spoken, as it is the working language for all positions. Soft Skills: You measure before and after, and trust numbers over impressions. Ownership of a problem from the first bad call to the fix in production. Benefits Flexible Work Setup: Work fully remotely or from a co-working space — whichever suits you best. Equipment Provided: Company laptop and phone provided for all employees. Collaborative Environment: Join a small, agile team where your contributions have a direct impact. Growth Opportunities: Work across the whole voice stack, from model serving to the conversation the caller hears. Closing If you want to make AI conversations feel human on a real phone line, we'd love to hear from you. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

descriptionAr: Senior Integrity Engineer Europe | Remote (hybrid near an Intero office) | 32-40 hours An inspection shows a client what is wrong. You show them what to do about it. Are you the integrity engineer people turn to when the inspection data is in and a decision has to be made? Do you enjoy combining fracture mechanics, corrosion growth and sound engineering judgment into advice an operator can actually act on? Then we would like to meet you. We are growing our Integrity team and are looking for our first Senior Integrity Engineer based in Europe. About Intero Intero Integrity Services helps pipeline operators and industrial companies keep their assets safe, compliant and running. With our own in-line inspection technology (including MFL and UT) we inspect pipelines and installations all over the world and tell clients exactly what condition their assets are in. Headquartered in Tricht, the Netherlands, we have over 40 years of experience and 650+ professionals from 25+ nationalities. Learn more about our Inspection service line in this video: Intero - The Power of Integrity . Your team You join a close-knit Integrity team of five, including you: a Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead in Vancouver, an Integrity Engineer in Mexico City and two Junior Integrity Engineers in Toronto and Calgary. The team is part of our Data Analysis (DA) department. Together the team delivers integrity reports for clients around the globe. You will be in daily contact with your teammates. The atmosphere is informal, communication is clear and transparent, and the pace follows the workload: some weeks are calm, others are full on. As the first team member in Europe, you strengthen our coverage of European time zones and clients. Why this role matters An inspection delivers a list of findings. For our clients, especially in highly regulated markets, a list of problems without a solution is not enough. That is where you come in. The Integrity team turns inspection results into a complete solution package: assessments, remaining life, and clear recommendations that help operators make well-founded decisions about the continued operation of their systems. In this role you raise the quality and consistency of that package, review the work of junior engineers, and help develop the tools and methods the team relies on. What your week looks like Part of your week goes to performing integrity assessments on pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers. The other part goes to supporting business development, developing methods and giving technical support. From day one you will work on Corrosion Growth (CG) reports and Fitness-for-Service (FFS) assessments. · Perform Level 1 and Level 2 FFS assessments and advanced Corrosion Growth Analysis (CGA); review or prepare Level 3 FFS assessments where projects require it. · Review the work of junior engineers, such as Run Comparison reports, dent strain and bending strain analyses, against the applicable codes and standards. · Act as the technical point of contact for project managers and clients on structural integrity questions, and support proposals and client-facing technical activities. · Align recommendations with local and national regulations, and build knowledge of codes and standards across jurisdictions. · Validate and help develop our in-house engineering tools, and write Python or VBA scripts to automate evaluations based on MFL and UT inspection data. · Set up and maintain internal procedures, technical questionnaires and quality checklists so every deliverable meets client and internal standards. · Manage several projects at the same time, and flag risks and priorities early. What you bring Must-haves · A degree in Mechanical and/or Materials (or Metallurgical) Engineering, ideally a combination of both. A Master's degree is a strong plus. · At least 5 years of relevant experience in the structural integrity of pressurised equipment, preferably pipelines, including independently performing and reviewing FFS assessments and remaining life calculations. · Strong working knowledge of fracture mechanics and corrosion and fatigue damage mechanisms. · Working knowledge of API 579 / ASME FFS-1, API 530, ASME B31G, DNV-RP-F101, API 1183, ASME VIII Div. 2 and ASME PCC-2, and of the international regulations for pipeline and pressure equipment integrity. · Experience with risk assessments and turning results into clear, actionable recommendations. · Strong mathematics and statistics, including probabilistic methods. · Programming skills to solve engineering problems, preferably in Python, VBA or MATLAB. · Mid to advanced-level training in integrity assessment methods. · You write clear, professional technical reports and explain complex topics to both technical and non-technical audiences. · You work independently with minimal supervision, keep your agreements, and are flexible with working hours to collaborate with colleagues in Canada and Mexico. · You are curious, proactive and a team player who suggests improvements to help the team work better and avoid rework. Nice-to-haves · Hands-on experience with finite element analysis (FEA), preferably ABAQUS. · Experience with creep assessment of boilers and heaters. · Exposure to Level 3 FFS assessments. · Experience with pipeline ILI data analysis (MFL/UT). · Experience with client-facing technical activities or proposals. · Experience in highly regulated industries. Why Intero · Work that makes a difference. Your recommendations directly determine whether critical pipelines and installations can keep operating safely. · Variety. Pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers; FFS Level 1 to 3, corrosion growth, dent strain and more, for clients all over the world. · Real influence. You help shape the team's methods, procedures and in-house tools, and see your ideas put into practice. · International team, flexible set-up.
